$comment: Hand-written per-icon copy: what the drawing is for, in one line. Source, not generated — there is nothing to generate it from, since the Figma descriptions are search terms rather than prose. Keyed by BASE name, so one drawing boxed three ways shares a line and lib/icon-pages.ts adds the container clause. Every line has to fit USAGE_LIMIT in lib/icon-usage.ts; pipeline/check-usage.mjs measures the real descriptions and lists anything missing.
